headline: Repsol announces €950 million share buyback and dividend increase
summary: Spanish energy company Repsol has launched a €950 million share buyback program for 2026 and raised its planned January 2027 dividend to €0.56 per share.
why: Share buybacks and dividend increases are common methods for energy companies to return excess cash flow to shareholders.

impacts.name: Repsol
impacts.why: Capital returns to shareholders are generally viewed positively.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Direct capital returns through buybacks and dividends often signal management confidence in future cash flows and improve earnings per share.
